definitions.explanation: Arts performed before an audience, including music, dance, theater, and other entertainment.

notes:
{芸能|げいのう} encompasses both traditional and modern performing arts and entertainment.

Traditional {芸能|げいのう}:
- ⟦{歌舞伎|かぶき}→歌舞伎：04455_kabuki⟧ (Kabuki theater)
- ⟦{能|のう}→能：01927_nou⟧ (Noh theater)
- ⟦{落語|らくご}→落語：04457_rakugo⟧ (comic storytelling)
- ⟦{雅楽|ががく}→雅楽：27354_gagaku⟧ (court music)

Modern {芸能|げいのう}:
- Music, comedy, TV entertainment
- ⟦{芸能界|げいのうかい}→芸能界：15094_geinoukai⟧ (entertainment industry/world)
- ⟦{芸能人|げいのうじん}→芸能人：14959_geinoujin⟧ (entertainer, celebrity)

- ⟦{芸能界|げいのうかい}→芸能界：15094_geinoukai⟧ (entertainment world/industry)
- ⟦{芸能人|げいのうじん}→芸能人：14959_geinoujin⟧ (entertainer)
